reviews.text: I left my cocker spaniel at this salon for grooming, and they quoted us €210 even though he was barely plucked. There are bald patches, and his face is still very long. In short, we managed to get the price down to €160, but it's still extremely expensive for a result that's nowhere near the standard of grooming he gets at other salons. We do not recommend this place for a cocker spaniel.

On my second visit to this salon, I was quoted €120, but when I went to pick up my dog, they asked for €150 because the groomers had "spent more time." I understand that this can happen, but in this case, a simple phone call to let me know would have been the least they could do.

Furthermore, my dog ​​had a red eye when we left, and the only response I got was, "I don't know"... Not reassuring.

The grooming service itself is fine, but their business practices really lack transparency and customer consideration. It's a shame, because with a little more communication and a better sense of service, the experience would be much better. They need to rethink their approach if they want to retain their clientele.
Great products, good advice, and a very warm welcome. Thank you.

My little dog Olive and I had a great first experience at this salon! It is a very cute place and we received a warm welcome. And from the way the groomer held Olive I knew my little girl was in good hands. My wishes and the expertise of the groomer created the look I wanted for Olive. I highly recommend this salon and I look forward to a long relationship with them. Merci!

During the car detailing sessions, the owner uses the old "garage mechanic" method, which involves taking your car apart before calling you to tell you there will be additional charges and that the price will be double the initial quote. Absolutely tasteless…😪 …

It's outright robbery. I simply asked for my dog ​​to be washed, nothing more!

They add services you didn't request! Nail trimming, ear cleaning. It's outright robbery! 85 euros for a small Jack Russell, just a wash, and they add extra charges! At that price, they should at least provide a quote! But all they had to do was wash him. Their pricing structure isn't clear! I find it very dishonest and I won't be going back!

A wonderful place for our furry friends. It has everything you could need: snacks, lunch, dinner (kibble or other treats), toys and accessories, and grooming and care for cats and dogs. Thank you so much, Maureen, from little Lily, whom you looked after this morning. She's delighted and relieved. See you very soon!
Nice shop, beautiful products (although excessively expensive), good grooming service but extremely unpleasant staff!

They took care perfectly of my dog, I am very happy with the grooming and the way they treated her.
Highly recommended.

Staff are quite French lol but it’s a cute store
Got my sausages nice well priced harnesses
Expect to pay around €100 for a dog haircut. Good service, but harness prices are excessive (over €150). Otherwise, good service.

Top notch collection of dog and cat accessories, clothing, beds, and carriers. I get TONS of complements on the harnesses and cross body leads I have bought for my dachshunds here. Very nice quality leather and totally passes as Hermés.

Prices are absolutely ludicrous though!
High-quality products with unparalleled elegance! Perfect for giving your pet all the luxury they deserve!

The prices of our two items at the checkout didn't match the prices displayed on the shelves! Unfortunately, we had already paid when we realized the deception. The manager had deliberately removed the price tags so we couldn't reprimand him, and new items with the correct price had been placed on the shelves. These fraudulent business practices are punishable by law. Beware of this cunning Bonnie and Clyde-style management couple!

The leash is great! I love it! 💕💕🩷🩷🩷
The owner designed all of these—they're really high-quality! ❤️ The cat toy is also adorable. …
